sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown; antennae, postclypeus, legs and meso- and metanotum yellow; pronotum slightly paler than the head; abdominal segments coloured as the pronotum, the anterior sternites paler in the middle. Head densely hairy, with short and long hairs intermixed; the rest of the body densely hairy; wings densely punctate. Body length with wings 10.0 mm, without wings 4.5 mm. Head widely oval, narrowed anteriorly (head length to the clypeal apex 1.14—1.18 mm, width 1.14—1.18 mm). Fontanelle oval, medium-sized. Eyes medium-sized, protruding. Ocelli medium-sized, separated from the eye by about their mean diameter (semi-diameter, after Ahmad 1958). Antennae 15-segmented; segments 2, 3 and 4 nearly equal in length, or segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus shorter than half its width. Pronotum medium wide and long (length 0.57 mm, width 0.95—1.03 mm); anterior margin weakly concave. Forewing length 8.0 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish white; left mandible black, right mandible reddish brown; body white. Head with scattered hairs; abdominal tergites moderately densely hairy, with long hairs intermixed posteriorly. Body length 4.0—4.5 mm. Head capsule flat, rectangular, columnar, about twice as long as wide (head length with mandibles 3.5—3.8 mm, without mandibles 2.09—2.18 mm, width 1.06—1.25 mm). Fontanelle punctiform. Antennae 13(?)—14-segmented; segment 3 as long as segment 2; segment 4 slightly shorter. Labrum short and broad anteriorly, anterior margin slightly concave, anterolateral corners very small. Mandibles asymmetrical, shorter than the head. Left mandible strongly twisted, length 1.24 mm; right mandible blade-shaped. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped; length 0.30 mm, width 0.72—0.91 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellowish white, body white, moderately densely hairy. Body length 2.7—3.5 mm. Head widely oval, narrowed anteriorly (width 0.87—0.91 mm). Fontanelle indistinct but present. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus moderately inflated, slightly shorter than half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a notch; width 0.49 mm.
